gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-13 only one of the three 2 kWh stations with a built-in TT-30 outlet is listed by its maker under $900 and marked available: the Renogy PowerStation 2000 at $849. The BLUETTI AC200L is sold out at $899 on bluettipower.com, and Anker's own store lists the C2000 Gen 2 at $1,199.99. Those two are the TT-30 picks ChatGPT recommended.
standout_why: I compared five pages. runtimemath.com/compare (cited) lists the AC200L as sold out but gives the C2000 Gen 2 as $899.99 on pre-order (read Nov 2), and it mentions no TT-30 outlet on any model. outagereadyhq.com under-$1,000 (cited) doesn't mention the AC200L, the C2000 Gen 2 price or TT-30 outlets. Our own cited page still shows the C2000 Gen 2 at $899.99 (read 2026-10-31) and says the AC200L was in stock on 2026-10-31. Home Depot (cited) blocked my fetch. None of these pages puts TT-30 outlet, today's maker price and stock status together, which is what shows which TT-30 unit you can actually buy under $900.
decides: It changes the pick. Every ChatGPT run chose the AC200L, and most named the C2000 Gen 2 as the TT-30 runner-up. Today the AC200L can't be bought from BLUETTI US, and the C2000 Gen 2 is $300 over budget at Anker. That leaves the Renogy PowerStation 2000 ($849, marked available in Renogy's store feed) as the only TT-30 2 kWh option under $900. If you plug appliances in directly and don't need the RV outlet, the in-stock choices under $900 are the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max ($879) and the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 ($899). Before we publish, check the Renogy stock status and TT-30 spec on its product page; see unsourced.
